item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 48, 2026 (23–29 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (23–29 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Python

  • expo/exact (Rust) ★ 5,248: Agent Native, Rust based, high performance way to build apps on web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux and other platforms.
  • EL4CTEO/fast-anything (Rust) ★ 4,582: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile your app, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the
